Name: Intelligent Recycling
Description:
[h2]Intelligent Recycling[/h2]

Ever opened a storage crate and discovered enough worn-out limbs, questionable organs, obsolete equipment, dead pests, and abandoned boarding hardware to assemble a deeply disappointing crew member? Well, have I got a responsible waste-management solution for you!

Intelligent Recycling watches for eligible objects and selected pest remains, applies your category and safety settings, and queues Stardeus's own Dispose, Disassemble, Deconstruct, construction, and upgrade tasks. Useful items can return to storage; worn-out clutter, invasive fungus, dead Crawlers, resolved event debris, and optionally lost Shuttle pads can finally become something productive.

[h2]Features[/h2]

[h3]Intelligent Disposal[/h3]
- Handles biological body parts, robotic body parts, and equipment independently
- Uses shared biological and robotic/equipment Quality thresholds managed by Intelligent Recycling
- Automatically disposes Artillery Fungus at any growth stage and dead Crawler corpses when a Nutrient Extractor is available
- Reacts promptly when items become loose, parts are removed, Crawlers die, processors are built, thresholds change, or fungus spawns
- Coalesces frequent object creation and carrier-release events into targeted dirty-object scans
- Retains a five-second full reconciliation scan and performs no automation scans while the game is paused
- Uses vanilla Dispose, Disassemble, and Deconstruct tasks rather than replacing Stardeus processing rules

[h3]Shared Quality Thresholds[/h3]
- Set biological and robotic/equipment thresholds directly in Intelligent Recycling
- Synchronizes each value to every matching Nutrient Extractor or Disassembler
- Facility-side changes update Intelligent Recycling and every peer in the same family
- Adds the otherwise-hidden biological threshold control to the Nutrient Extractor tab
- Migrates existing saves from their highest constructed facility thresholds so the effective cutoff is preserved

[h3]Event and Pest Cleanup[/h3]
- Disassembles landed Hullpiercers
- Disassembles Storage Capsules only after they have been opened
- Disassembles Safe Boxes only after they have been opened
- Deconstructs opened Stasis Pods while protecting active Merchant/Trade pods
- Deconstructs Breach Capsule Ports only after raiders are released or Stardeus resolves a failed spawn
- Disposes only dead Crawlers; living and incapacitated Crawlers are never targeted
- Provides an independent, default-enabled toggle for every established special cleanup path

[h3]Optional Lost Shuttle Pad Replacement[/h3]
- Detects Shuttle pads Core has permanently marked Lost
- Uses ordinary Deconstruction, construction, and Install Upgrade work to replace the pad at the same position and rotation
- Remembers the exact installed upgrade assignments and requeues them after construction
- The tooltip reports the current save's conditional return-event share when available; the equal-weight full-pool reference is about 5.6%, or one of 18 built-in Positive candidates
- Core provides no fixed return deadline or guaranteed lifetime return percentage
- Disabled by default because removing the original lost pad permanently closes that Shuttle's return route

[h3]Dynamic Category Controls[/h3]
- Discovers Body Part and Equipment categories from currently loaded definitions
- Supports compatible categories added by other mods
- Provides separate biological and robotic controls for each applicable body-part category
- Uses native Stardeus body-part icons and clear N/A states when no counterpart exists
- Preserves child category choices while a parent option is disabled

[h3]Persistent Interface and Statistics[/h3]
- Uses Auto Utilities Mod Framework 1.4.0 for its cooperative Recycling widget and managed, freely resizable Main/Settings panel
- Responsive setting cards reflow as the panel width changes
- Body part category card shells, title bars, and titles follow the selected Stardeus theme and live theme reloads
- Automation, Equipment, and other selection/state toggle cards intentionally retain their established semantic colors
- Displays current tracked tasks, last-scan results, and accumulated Biological, Robotic, Equipment, and lost-Shuttle replacement totals
- Accumulated statistics can be cleared without affecting active work or settings
- Settings, thresholds, statistics, scan results, and tracked object, Being, deconstruction, and lost-Shuttle replacement work survive save and load
- Includes an optional persistent keyboard shortcut for opening or closing the panel, with assignment and conflict protection managed by AUMF

[h3]Optional Storage-Haul Replacement[/h3]
- Can replace an unassigned storage-haul task with eligible recycling work
- Never interrupts hauling already assigned to a worker
- Disabled by default so vanilla storage behavior remains untouched unless explicitly enabled

[h3]Read-Only Compatibility API[/h3]
- Exposes versioned snapshots of settings, categories, managed processor thresholds, scan state, totals, tracked tasks, special targets, and shortcut status
- Provides authoritative per-object ownership and release decisions so hauling mods can cooperate without duplicating Intelligent Recycling rules
- Returns immutable data and never lets consumers change settings, tasks, logs, or interface state

[h2]Safety Rules[/h2]

The normal Quality-threshold workflow only considers loose active objects supported by Stardeus's disposable-item system. Stored, forbidden, busy, or otherwise assigned objects are left alone. Materials are outside the mod's scope. Artillery Fungus is an explicit biological exception to quality filtering because Core exposes it as disposable at every growth stage. Dead Crawlers are an explicit Being-level exception and must match both the Crawler species and Dead state before the mod requests Stardeus's vanilla Dispose task. Constructed objects are considered only by the explicitly supported Stasis Pod, Breach Capsule Port, and opt-in Lost Shuttle cleanup paths after their safety conditions are satisfied.

Lost Shuttle replacement uses normal Core jobs and real materials. Enabling it is a deliberate tradeoff: once the original lost pad is deconstructed, its deserter can no longer return with that Shuttle. The tooltip exposes the current conditional story-event share where Core can calculate it so this choice is informed.

Brain, Core, mind-bearing, and mind-associated parts are permanently protected. Their category controls are hidden and disabled below the UI layer so old or altered save data cannot expose them to automation.

[h2]Requirements[/h2]

Requires Auto Utilities Mod Framework 1.4.0. Intelligent Recycling registers its tested feature level through AUMF's compatibility handshake and skips framework-dependent initialization when AUMF reports an incompatible version.

[h2]In Short[/h2]

You set the processor thresholds. You choose the categories. Stardeus performs the work.

[b]The clutter gets recycled intelligently.[/b]
